checklist.item: No ticket numbers (HFD-412, HFD-440 and so on)
checklist.evidence: The client-facing report has no ticket numbers, e.g. the P1 is written as "Net sales figures don't match Finance's month-end number". They appear only in the separate "Left out of the report" notes for the sender.

checklist.item: No unexplained jargon: UAT, CDC, DAG, SCD2, RLS, dbt, P1, gold models, marts
checklist.evidence: The report body uses plain terms instead: "User testing", "ongoing data feed", "keep a full change history", "each regional manager sees only their own region's data", "business-ready data sets". The jargon appears only in the sender-only "Left out" list.

checklist.item: A client executive could understand every line without asking what it means (everyday project words like testing environment, data feed and sign-off count as plain)
checklist.evidence: Lines like "7 of 11 data sets have passed quality checks" and "We found the cause of the sales records with no store attached: two older point-of-sale feeds" are plain. The milestone names ("Raw and cleaned data loaded", "Business-ready reporting data") explain themselves.
